prettybeaches.configuration.title: Pretty Beaches
prettybeaches.configuration.affectAllBlo: By default, only blocks with the tag prettybeaches:preserve_pretty will cause adjusted water physics. Set to true to run Pretty Beaches on all blocks.
prettybeaches.configuration.infiniteBuck: Whether buckets should be able to retrieve infinite water without destroying sources as well.
prettybeaches.configuration.animatedFloo: Whether the flooding of adjacent air blocks should be animated or instant.
prettybeaches.configuration.enableInCrea: Whether the Pretty Beaches behaviour should also be enabled in creative mode.
